subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers refresh the open conflicting fork PR for this issue, or close/supersede it and allow a new narrow same-repo repair?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but an open linked PR uses closing syntax and the issue is already marked no-new-fix-pr, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers pick the canonical path.

options.title: Replace With Same-Repo Repair
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor a focused same-repo fix covering custom-prompt mutation plus prompt-boundary visibility.

options.title: Refresh The Fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to rebase it, add real behavior proof, and expand coverage if prompt-boundary behavior remains in scope.

options.title: Pause For Owner Triage
options.body: Keep this issue open without new repair automation until the heartbeat prompt-boundary owner decides the exact fix shape.

recommendation.title: Replace With Same-Repo Repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor a focused same-repo fix covering custom-prompt mutation plus prompt-boundary visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the introduced path-hint behavior and authored the first same-repo repair attempt.
